item.title: Trump Blames Minnesota Governor, Not Iran, for Cyberattacks on State's Water Systems
item.description: Trump attributed cyberattacks on Minnesota's water systems to the state's Democratic governor.

item.title: DHS prohibits 43 Chinese firms from operating in the US
item.description: These firms are barred from importing goods into the United States.

item.title: WATCH: Brothers play same position on same NFL team
item.description: Aveion and A.J. Terrell talk about both being cornerbacks for the Atlanta Falcons.

item.title: Scary footage shows European wildfires displacing over 250,000 in France, Spain, and beyond
item.description: At least one death and over 250,000 evacuations have been reported as wildfires spread across Western Europe in July.
